messages:
Harper Lin: Heads-up team  finalizing social execution for the "Serving Patterns" launch. Need: X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn carousel (3 cards + variant), 15-20s teaser, and an explicit inbound lead routing spec. Can we close owners + schedule by EOD?

Noelle Gray: I can draft copy. Proposed cadence: X -> Tue 11:00 PT (register CTA), LinkedIn -> Wed 10:00 PT (watch-live CTA). UTMs: utm_campaign=serving_patterns_launch_q3&utm_source=social&utm_medium=organic.

Samira Khan: I'll design assets: 20s teaser + two carousel variants (tech-first, outcome-first). Need speaker headshots and final hero line. Also will export square + landscape and a GIF for X.

Diego Morales: Headshots are in Drive:/Marketing/ServingPatterns/heads. Will add speaker one-liners in the shared doc. For captions: burn captions for LI autoplay, separate SRT for accessibility.

Harper Lin: Routing: HubSpot form -> list 'SP_LAUNCH_Q3'. Requirements: 1) form submit -> add to list + send confirmation email + calendar invite; 2) registrant attends -> SFDC Lead.Status = "Webinar - Attended" + create SDR task assigned to the regional owner; 3) if registrant asks a sales question in Q&A -> tag lead "sales_interest" and escalate. Also tag with variant=a or variant=b depending on X AB. Samira, can we include short link with utm_content=variantA/B?

Samira Khan: Yes. Will output two short links: short.ly/servingA and short.ly/servingB and embed utm_content accordingly. Uploading assets now (Drive link in doc).

Noelle Gray: Draft X thread (compact, 4 tweets):
Tweet1: "Serving LLMs reliably isn't magic. It's patterns. Join our engineers for the playbook. 1/4"
Tweet2 (A): "Caching + batching: the two patterns that cut cost and stabilize latency. 2/4"
Tweet2 (B): "Outcome-first: teams cut unit cost ~40% with these serving moves. 2/4"
Tweet3: "Live demo: routing, graceful degradation, and rollouts. 3/4"
Tweet4: "Register -> short.ly/servingA?utm_campaign=serving_patterns_launch_q3&utm_content=variantA (or servingB for B). 4/4"

Harper Lin: Nice. We'll run AB on Tweet2. Make sure copy length fits native X limits and that links are final. Also add inline speaker handles for tweet1.

Diego Morales: Uploaded teaser v1 + GIF + both carousel variants. Exported: MP4 1080x1080, MP4 1200x675, GIF 800x450. Added alt text and SRT.

link-bot: Short link created: short.ly/servingA -> https://redwood.ai/serving?utm_campaign=serving_patterns_launch_q3&utm_content=variantA. Short link created: short.ly/servingB -> https://redwood.ai/serving?utm_campaign=serving_patterns_launch_q3&utm_content=variantB.

Samira Khan: Design notes: carousel v1 = technical flow (patterns), v2 = outcome-first (results + metric). First card = hero + speaker 1-liners, last card = CTA + short link + UTM. Will add logo lock and subtle motion in teaser.

Harper Lin: HubSpot workflow checklist (Harper): 1) form -> add to 'SP_LAUNCH_Q3' list; 2) auto-confirm + calendar invite; 3) on-attend -> set SFDC status + create SDR task; 4) add lead properties: source_social, variant, originating_post_id; 5) send post-webinar survey email. I'll share the HS export after mapping SFDC owners.

Noelle Gray: Small edit: tweet4 should read "Register -> short.ly/servingA (if you saw variant A)" to avoid confusion. Also add a pinned reply with speaker bios on X.

Samira Khan: Done. Uploaded final assets and pinned-reply copy. Also attached a 30-second cut for email promo.

Diego Morales: Quick QA note: LI carousel card 2 had contrast issue; adjusted CTAs and re-uploaded.

Harper Lin: Owners locked: Copy + AB variants: Noelle. Assets + exports: Samira. Scheduling + calendar posting: Harper. HubSpot + routing: Harper (with SFDC mapping). Please react with :thumbsup: if youre set.

Noelle Gray: :thumbsup:

Samira Khan: :thumbsup:

Diego Morales: :thumbsup:

Harper Lin: Thanks team  I'll paste the HS workflow export and calendar entries into #marketing-ops and confirm the scheduled times with the scheduler bot before EOD.
